name: Seize the Moment [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You and your allies are poised to pounce whenever one of you scores a telling blow.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, Improved Critical.

Benefit(s): When you confirm a critical hit against an opponent that your ally also threatens, your ally can make an attack of opportunity against that opponent.

Polymorph: Spiritual Ally, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: G. Tyler Ernst.
